text: I generally feel good about who I am and what I have to offer.
I often compare myself unfavorably to others and feel like I fall short.
I can accept compliments gracefully without dismissing them or feeling uncomfortable.
My inner voice is often critical, telling me I'm not good enough or that I'll fail.
I feel confident taking on new challenges, even when the outcome is uncertain.
I tend to dwell on my mistakes long after they've happened.
I feel worthy of love, success, and good things happening to me.
I avoid trying new things because I'm afraid of failing or looking foolish.
I can set healthy boundaries without feeling guilty about it.
When I face a setback, I bounce back fairly quickly rather than spiraling into self-doubt.
I feel proud of the progress I have made in my personal growth.
I often seek validation or approval from others before making a decision.
I feel comfortable standing up for myself when I'm treated unfairly.
I believe my opinions and feelings deserve to be heard and respected.
I feel at peace with my physical appearance most of the time.
I often feel like an imposter who will be found out sooner or later.
I treat myself with the same kindness I would show a good friend.
I feel secure enough in myself that other people's criticism doesn't define me.
I often feel like I don't quite belong or fit in wherever I am.
I acknowledge my achievements rather than downplaying or dismissing them.
